name: Command: Undead applies Expunge to a diseased enemy (#4058)
contract: Expunge 705754 (CharacterAdvancement 34982, Death tab) reads "Casting Command spells on an enemy now applies Expunge if they are Diseased." Command: Undead 504868 is the generic Command spell: SpellFamilyName 29 with family flags word 2 0x81000000, so AscensionNecromancer::Command matches it, and AscensionNecromancerAbilities.cpp lets it start without minions. OnSpellCast casts the trigger 500443 on a valid Command target when the caster has 705754, and the hit handler applies Expunge 573233 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_FROM_CASTER +10%, 10 sec, 2 stacks) only when the target carries one of the Necromancer's diseases. 500443's TargetAuraSpell 802913 (Plagued, no acquisition) blocked every application until the load contract cleared it. Expected: Command: Undead on an enemy without the Necromancer's disease applies nothing; after Flesh to Worms 500338 the next Command: Undead applies one Expunge stack from the Necromancer, a second adds a stack, and Flesh to Worms is then taken at x1.20.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: the Expunge talent is active
Command: Undead against an enemy that is not diseased
CONTROL: no Expunge without the Necromancer's disease
SETUP: the golem carries Flesh to Worms
DISCRIMINATING: Command: Undead on the diseased golem applies Expunge
The second Command: Undead adds a stack
Two stacks raise disease damage taken by 20%
